name: VidPal
summary: Autonomous content engine for faceless and topic-based channels: it discovers trending stories in your niche, auto-generates short-form videos and carousels with AI voiceovers, and auto-publishes them across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and more.
best_for: creators and small brands running faceless or topic-based channels that want the trend-find, generate and auto-publish loop handled in one tool across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube
skip_if: you want hands-on creative control over every video, or your brand can't afford auto-published AI content going out without a human check
honest_knock: Credits don't carry over month to month, and a few users report slow support/account responses, so run the free plan through a full create-and-publish loop before you pay.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month billed annually ($144/yr), or $19 month to month
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-10-07 against the vendor's own pricing page and confirmed by VidPal in writing) (2026) Free: 4 lifetime credits, standard-quality exports, "Made with Vidpal.ai" watermark, no card. Starter $12/mo billed annually ($144/yr) or $19 month to month, 15 credits/mo; Pro $23/mo annually ($276/yr) or $39 month to month, 40 credits, auto-publish and scheduling, 2K exports; Business $41/mo annually ($492/yr) or $69 month to month, 100 credits, 4K, three daily slots; Enterprise on quote. One credit is a Reel, a carousel, an editing upload or ten minutes of clip source; an AI Avatar or long-form video is five. Monthly credits do not roll over, annual credits arrive as a yearly pool, and top-up packs expire after 60 days. Refunds cover the unused credit balance within 30 days.

price_history.method: Stable = every amount on the vendor's pricing page identical across >= 3 of our reads over >= 30 days. A change is listed only after we confirmed the new price on the page, with a verbatim quote. Differences in raw readings are never published on their own.

claims.observed: After Confirm script & generate voice the credit counter went at once to 1 / 4 (3 credits left), before any video existed, and it stayed at 1 / 4 when the render did not finish. The Free plan has 4 lifetime credits.

claims.plan: Free plan; the Starter monthly checkout was viewed, nothing was paid
claims.comparability: The wait time on the page against our own stopwatch of one render; no second render was tried.
claims.buying_consequence: The page promises 30-90 seconds and our one run did not finish in 21 minutes; one run is not a measure of how often this happens.

exit_test.what: Account and start: the account was created by us and was signed in; our AI assistant ran the test in our Chrome from 14:24 (Amsterdam). The interface was in English. The onboarding asked How did you hear about us? and Google search was chosen. Core action: Studio, Create New, Short 9:16, From Prompt with the text 3 tips to wax a snowboard (Sample Snowboards), 30s, Stock Footage, Hook Intro None and no avatar. At 14:26:00 Generate Short Video (1 cr) was clicked and the script was ready after about 25 seconds: 3 Pro Tips for Perfect Snowboard Waxing, 3 sections, about 80 words. At about 14:26:50 Confirm script & generate voice was clicked and the credit counter went at once to 1 / 4 (3 credits left). That is the moment the video counts, with or without a result. After that the page stayed on Generating voice & captions and Generating media for each section. After about 3 minutes it said Taking longer than usual and offered Try again; Try again was pressed 2 times and the answer was Voice or render is in progress. Wait for it to finish before retrying auto-assign. At 14:39 the Studio list still said GENERATING MEDIA (more than 12 minutes). At 14:47, 21 minutes after the start, the same concept (no new credits, no new attempt) still showed the badge GENERATING MEDIA, 30s and Short, the credits 1 / 4 used, a black preview with Generating voice & captions, and per section only Assign and AI image with no clip assigned. The Edit Script & Voice tab said Script is locked. Result in this one run: not reached after 12+ min, 2 retries, 1 of 4 credits used. No preview and no export were seen, so the watermark, the resolution, the length and the quality of a finished video were not measured. Nothing is said here about the cause. Plans: Billing page of the app, read by the tester on 18 Nov 2026, with the banner Limited-time launch offer, 50% off all plans for life-time. Free: $0, 4 lifetime credits, a Made with Vidpal.ai watermark on exports, AI Avatar and long-form locked. Annual: Starter $12 a month (struck through $24), billed $144, 180 credits a year; Pro $23 (struck through $46), $276, 480 a year, with auto-publish and 2K; Business $41 (struck through $82), $492, 1200 a year, with 4K. Monthly: Starter $19 (struck through $38), 15 credits a month; Pro $39 (struck through $78), 40 a month; Business $69 (struck through $138), 100 a month. The public page vidpal.ai/pricing was read again just before this delivery the same day with the same prices in both views (annual $12, $23 and $41 with $24, $46 and $82 struck through, billed $144, $276 and $492; monthly $19, $39 and $69 with $38, $78 and $138 struck through) and the same banner. So the prices are unchanged against the dossier. The deviation is that the dossier names only the struck through annual prices; the monthly view also has struck through prices. The credit card in the app said 3 from this month's plan; the free credits are 4 lifetime credits. Checkout: for Starter monthly the checkout of Dodo Payments (shown for the Netherlands) said EUR 17.33 a month plus VAT EUR 3.64, total EUR 20.97, against $19 on the plan card; nothing was filled in and the tester went back. No screenshot was kept because the page showed a name and Dutch text. Cancelling: the app has no button to cancel a plan or to delete the account. The Account page has only connections, a name and a password reset by e-mail; the avatar menu has Account, Billing, Change picture and Sign out; Help & feedback is a form to the founder (cancelled before sending). The dossier names an e-mail route for cancelling and refunds, which was not used. Not tested: export, watermark, resolution, video quality, publishing, the connections (deliberately not linked), a paid plan and the payment. Clean up: the account and one Studio concept (3 Pro Tips for Perfect Snowboard Waxing, still GENERATING MEDIA) stay; the own tab of the retry was closed; nothing was bought. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Confirming the script took 1 of the 4 free credits before any video existed, and when the render did not finish the credit was still gone. The page says that crafting the video usually takes 30-90 seconds; in our one run it was still pending after 21 minutes, and the retry was refused while the render counted as in progress. The Free plan puts a watermark on exports (not seen by us). The app shows no button to cancel or delete the account; the dossier points to an e-mail route.

exit_test.what: Account and start: the account was created by us and was signed in; our AI assistant ran the test in our Chrome from 14:24 (Amsterdam). The interface was in English. The onboarding asked How did you hear about us? and Google search was chosen. Core action: Studio, Create New, Short 9:16, From Prompt with the text 3 tips to wax a snowboard (Sample Snowboards), 30s, Stock Footage, Hook Intro None and no avatar. At 14:26:00 Generate Short Video (1 cr) was clicked and the script was ready after about 25 seconds: 3 Pro Tips for Perfect Snowboard Waxing, 3 sections, about 80 words. At about 14:26:50 Confirm script & generate voice was clicked and the credit counter went at once to 1 / 4 (3 credits left). That is the moment the video counts, with or without a result. After that the page stayed on Generating voice & captions and Generating media for each section. After about 3 minutes it said Taking longer than usual and offered Try again; Try again was pressed 2 times and the answer was Voice or render is in progress. Wait for it to finish before retrying auto-assign. At 14:39 the Studio list still said GENERATING MEDIA (more than 12 minutes). At 14:47, 21 minutes after the start, the same concept (no new credits, no new attempt) still showed the badge GENERATING MEDIA, 30s and Short, the credits 1 / 4 used, a black preview with Generating voice & captions, and per section only Assign and AI image with no clip assigned. The Edit Script & Voice tab said Script is locked. Result in this one run: not reached after 12+ min, 2 retries, 1 of 4 credits used. No preview and no export were seen, so the watermark, the resolution, the length and the quality of a finished video were not measured. Nothing is said here about the cause. Plans: Billing page of the app, read by the tester on 18 Nov 2026, with the banner Limited-time launch offer, 50% off all plans for life-time. Free: $0, 4 lifetime credits, a Made with Vidpal.ai watermark on exports, AI Avatar and long-form locked. Annual: Starter $12 a month (struck through $24), billed $144, 180 credits a year; Pro $23 (struck through $46), $276, 480 a year, with auto-publish and 2K; Business $41 (struck through $82), $492, 1200 a year, with 4K. Monthly: Starter $19 (struck through $38), 15 credits a month; Pro $39 (struck through $78), 40 a month; Business $69 (struck through $138), 100 a month. The public page vidpal.ai/pricing was read again just before this delivery the same day with the same prices in both views (annual $12, $23 and $41 with $24, $46 and $82 struck through, billed $144, $276 and $492; monthly $19, $39 and $69 with $38, $78 and $138 struck through) and the same banner. So the prices are unchanged against the dossier. The deviation is that the dossier names only the struck through annual prices; the monthly view also has struck through prices. The credit card in the app said 3 from this month's plan; the free credits are 4 lifetime credits. Checkout: for Starter monthly the checkout of Dodo Payments (shown for the Netherlands) said EUR 17.33 a month plus VAT EUR 3.64, total EUR 20.97, against $19 on the plan card; nothing was filled in and the tester went back. No screenshot was kept because the page showed a name and Dutch text. Cancelling: the app has no button to cancel a plan or to delete the account. The Account page has only connections, a name and a password reset by e-mail; the avatar menu has Account, Billing, Change picture and Sign out; Help & feedback is a form to the founder (cancelled before sending). The dossier names an e-mail route for cancelling and refunds, which was not used. Not tested: export, watermark, resolution, video quality, publishing, the connections (deliberately not linked), a paid plan and the payment. Clean up: the account and one Studio concept (3 Pro Tips for Perfect Snowboard Waxing, still GENERATING MEDIA) stay; the own tab of the retry was closed; nothing was bought. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Confirming the script took 1 of the 4 free credits before any video existed, and when the render did not finish the credit was still gone. The page says that crafting the video usually takes 30-90 seconds; in our one run it was still pending after 21 minutes, and the retry was refused while the render counted as in progress. The Free plan puts a watermark on exports (not seen by us). The app shows no button to cancel or delete the account; the dossier points to an e-mail route.
